title: Oppo Find X10 to feature dual 200MP cameras, Pro Max gets Open Gate
description: Oppo has revealed new camera details of the Find X10 and the top-end Find X10 Pro Max. Notably, the company recently confirmed that both phones will pack an 8,000mAh battery. The Oppo Find X10 will come with dual 200MP rear cameras, making it the first standard model in a flagship series to offer such a setup. Oppo has also revealed that the handset will feature a 0.99mm display bezel. The primary camera will use a 200MP sensor with an f/1.6 aperture, developed in collaboration with Hasselblad. It will also offer CIPA 6.0 professional-grade stabilization. The telephoto...

title: vivo X500's new design revealed ahead of launch
description: The vivo X500 series is set to launch in China on September 21. After recently teasing the X500 Pro Max’s design, the company has now revealed the updated design of the standard vivo X500, along with its available color options. Unlike its predecessor, the vivo X300, the upcoming vivo X500 will feature a redesigned rear panel. The phone gets a new camera layout with a large circular module positioned toward the left. The LED flash sits outside the circular module, while the entire camera setup is housed within a raised rectangular camera plateau that stretches across the width of...

title: Apple iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, Watch Series 12, Ultra 4 coverage wrap-up
description: Apple's 2026 iPhone event is now done, and it was an unusual one. We finally got to see Apple's inaugural folding iPhone, and it's intriguing, to say the least. It looks to be yet another product category that Apple was late to, but at which it arrived with its typical refinement and specialness. We'll see. We also got the new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, both of which got a new main camera lens with a variable f/1.5 to f/4.0 aperture. The latest non-Pro AirPods are here. title: Apple raises prices of the iPhone 17 series, iPhone Air and iPhone 16
description: As expected, Apple has quietly raised the prices of several existing iPhone models shortly after announcing the iPhone 18 Pro lineup and its all-new foldable iPhone Duo. The price increase affects the iPhone 17, iPhone 17e, iPhone Air, and iPhone 16. The models mentioned above are now $100 more expensive than their respective launch prices, with the base iPhone 17 now starting at $899 in the US. The iPhone 17e now starts at $699, while the iPhone Air starts at $1,099. Meanwhile, the iPhone 16 is priced at $799 for the 128GB base model in the US. The price increase applies across...

title: Samsung starts selling Certified Re-Newed Galaxy S26, S26+, and S26 Ultra in the UK
description: Samsung's Certified Re-Newed program, which offers 'like new' refurbished devices through its official online store, has now added the Galaxy S26, Galaxy S26+, and Galaxy S26 Ultra in the UK. You can score a Certified Re-Newed S26 for £739 with 256GB of storage and £899 with 512GB, an S26+ with 256GB of storage for £929 and with 512GB for £1,079, and an S26 Ultra with 256GB of storage for £1,079, with 512GB for £1,239, and with 1TB for £1,469. title: Global Oppo A7 Pro and A7 Pro Max spotted on Geekbench
description: Oppo launched the A7 Pro Max in China in August and the A7 Pro yesterday, and it seems like both devices are headed to global markets as well. Both of them have now been spotted in the Geekbench online database, and there's some good news regarding the few specs that the benchmark reveals. It very well could be that both the A7 Pro and A7 Pro Max will be identical globally to their Chinese counterparts. title: The Honor Magic9 Pro Max stars in a hands-on video before its official announcement
description: The Honor Magic9 series will be unveiled at the end of this month and we think that it will have three members – the Magic9, the 9 Pro and the Magic9 Pro Max. The latter, painted in the Moss Green color that we’ve seen in teasers, starred in an early unboxing and hands-on video. The video was posted on Weibo – you can watch it here. It starts by going over the exterior of the phone. The “Oreo” style camera island of the Magic8 series is replaced by a mix of round elements and a full-width rectangle. description: Sony launched the Xperia 1 VIII, its latest flagship smartphone, back in May, and released it in June. Now we already have a rumor about its successor, which we assume will be called the Xperia 1 IX. [#InlinePriceWidget,14660,1#] This device will allegedly sport a main camera with a larger sensor than the Xperia 1 VIII's 1/1.35" type. title: The Galaxy Z Fold8 and Z Fold8 Ultra are beating Galaxy Z Fold7's sales numbers in Europe
description: Back in August, Samsung revealed that pre-orders in Europe for the Galaxy Z Fold8, Z Fold8 Ultra and Z Flip8 were 20% higher than the pre-orders for the Z Fold7 and Z Flip7 last year. The new foldables have continued to gain momentum since then. Now, Samsung says that the combined Z Fold8 and Z Fold8 Ultra sales are 50% higher than the Z Fold7 last year (note that this stat doesn't include Z Flip sales, unlike the pre-order number). Okay, it’s two phones against one, but this shows that there was a wide foldable-shaped hole in Samsung’s Galaxy Z line-up. This conclusion is also...

title: iPhone Duo gets two official first-party cases, here they are
description: The iPhone Duo is Apple's first foldable smartphone, and alongside it, the company today also unveiled two official first-party cases for the device. The iPhone Duo Folio is going to be available in navy blue and taupe, and it has an integrated kickstand which supports a wide range of viewing angles. It folds away neatly when not in use. iPhone Duo Folio The iPhone Duo case is thin and light, according to Apple, and will be available in sand and navy blue. title: This is when Apple is releasing iOS 27
description: Today Apple unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. These devices will go on pre-order on September 12 and will be released on September 18. They will both be running iOS 27, which Apple announced back in June and has been working on ever since. Today Apple has also revealed when the stable version of iOS 27 will become available for eligible iPhones, following the usual months-long beta testing period. That date is Monday, September 14. title: Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 get S11 chip, microphones for Audio Intelligence
description: Apple's new watches just arrived - meet the Series 12 and the Watch Ultra 4. All three (Series 12 comes in 42mm and 46mm) feature the new S11 chip, improved optical/electrical heart rate sensors, and an upgraded Health Sensing System. Apple boldly says that its new wearables have the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable, something it has verified through a study of more than 1,000 participants, comparing against industry-leading competitors. Both new smartwatches will measure your heart rate every 5 seconds, while heart rate variability is measured 24 times more frequently...

title: iPhone 18 Pro and Duo pricing overview
description: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max are now official and they are joined by the first foldable from the brand – the iPhone Duo. The 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max will launch for pre-order across the first wave of 65 countries, including the US, the UK, Germany, Australia, Canada, China, France, India, South Korea, and others, this Saturday, September 12. Shipments will start from September 18. Another 20 countries will get the iPhones from September 25. title: Apple AirPods 5 are better, but surprisingly also cheaper
description: Apple's latest base AirPods are here, and it's all good news - you're getting better sound, more powerful noise cancellation, and the price is lower, spec-for-spec. Before we continue, let's get one thing out of the way - this is the non-Pro earbud, with the open-ear design. AirPods 5 comes in two versions - one with the regular USB-C case, and one with a wireless charging case and stem touch controls. Both models have ANC this time, and Apple claims the AirPods 5 have the the best active noise cancellation for an open-ear design on the market. Elaborating further, Apple says the...

title: It's here: Apple iPhone Duo is the first iOS-powered foldable smartphone
description: Apple has finally unveiled its first ever foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo. As usually happens these days, the rumors and leaks were all spot on (well, except for the name). The iPhone Duo's screens have the same aspect ratio, and the foldable screen has an under-display selfie camera. The titanium hinge has an integrated magnet array that satisfyingly snaps it shut. Touch ID is integrated into the side button, as you'd expect from a foldable, but you can also unlock the iPhone Duo with your Apple Watch. It has a 7.6" main folding screen and a 5.4" cover display. title: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max arrive with A20 Pro chip, smaller Dynamic Island and variable aperture main cams
description: The iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max are here, and they may look a lot like their predecessors, but they also bring enough new additions under the hood. On the outside, we have three new colors and a smaller Dynamic Island, while the internals bring the A20 Pro chip, larger batteries and variable-aperture main cams. Burgundy is the new hero color, and it is joined by glacier (blue), black and silver. The new Pros get the same 6.3 and 6.9-inch LTPO Super Retina XDR OLED panels with the same resolution, refresh rates and brightness as the outgoing models. The new bit is the narrower...

title: Samsung details the journey of making the Z Fold8 and Z Fold8 Ultra thinner and lighter
description: The original Galaxy Fold weighed a hefty 276g – and that isn’t even the heaviest Fold. That honor goes to the Z Fold2, which tipped the scales at 282g. And yet Samsung’s latest book-style foldable is only 201g. Okay, to be fair, this refers to the Galaxy Z Fold8, which has a smaller form factor than previous Folds. This is the story of how Samsung engineers made their Z foldables both lighter and thinner. The Galaxy Z Fold7 achieved an ambitious goal. description: Mere hours before Apple's grand iPhone unveiling event is set to start, Apple's new CEO, John Ternus, has posted a mysterious video on his official X account. description: Honor is officially announcing the Magic9 series, including the Magic9 Pro Max, on September 28.
